title: Identification of Novel Stacking Faults in Chiral InSeI Nanowires
content: InSeI is a quasi-one-dimensional semiconductor which has gained prominence for being a stable, inorganic chiral material [1]. While the structure of this material has been thoroughly characterized by both x-ray diffraction [2] and electron microscopy [3], no work has been performed to understand what defects exist in InSeI. These studies are critical, as the defects present in the material will likely change many attractive optical properties of InSeI, such as the direct bandgap [4] and chirality-induced spin splitting [5]. Here, high-resolution electron microscopy techniques are used to image the structural (dis)order in InSeI.
